What if Slughorn’s role in Voldemort’s story began long before he explained Horcruxes to Tom Riddle?

Today Ben dives into the Wizarding World of Harry Potter and Voldemort’s past. From Merope Gaunt and the Slug Club to Tom’s first connections at Hogwarts, we’re tracing a theory that puts Horace Slughorn at nearly every turning point in Voldemort’s rise. Then there’s a strange run of luck involving Harry, the Half-Blood Prince’s potion book, and Felix Felicis that may have helped bring Voldemort down.

Did Slughorn accidentally help create the Dark Lord and give Harry the means to defeat him? Let’s dive on in!
